title: OKX Gets New Funding From Circle, Standard Chartered at $25B Valuation
summary: Bitcoin Magazine OKX Gets New Funding From Circle, Standard Chartered at $25B Valuation The crypto exchange has raised new funding from the likes of Circle and Standard Chartered as it races to tokenize real-world assets.
